newsitem.title: UK: Travis Perkins appoints Hampden-Smith FD.
newsitem.headline: Travis Perkins appoints Hampden-Smith FD.

text.p: Travis Perkins Plc, the UK building materials company, said on Monday it was appointing Paul Hampden-Smith finance director after restructuring the group's head office.
His predecessor Terry Best was leaving the company "by mutual agreement", said Travis Perkins, which earlier posted a slight rise in first half pretax profits to 17.22 million stg from 16.91 million.
Hampden-Smith had been the finance director of Travis Perkins' main subsidiary, Travis Perkins Trading Company, which had seen significant growth over recent years, the firm said.
